name: d299-six-current-template-idempotency
command: import sys,json,copy; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,".claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/tools"); from edition import normalize_lesson_layout,prose_flow_contract,validate_lesson_identity; current=json.loads(Path(".intentfold/tickets/STEMROBIN-181/tmp/d1816-d299-current-figure-text/result.json").read_text()); results=[]; [(normalize_lesson_layout(new),results.append({"path":row["template"]["path"],"equal":new==old,"flowErrors":prose_flow_contract(new["prose"],new["section_breaks"])[1],"identityErrors":validate_lesson_identity(old["source"]["data"],new)})) for row in current["templates"] for old in [json.loads(Path(row["template"]["path"]).read_text())] for new in [copy.deepcopy(old)]]; print(json.dumps(results)); assert all(row["equal"] and not row["flowErrors"] and not row["identityErrors"] for row in results)
